evidence.FACTS: Rewritten against E-legal-digest: art. 56 documents to carry (registration certificate, licence matching vehicle, compulsory civil-liability insurance certificate of the owner, inspection certificate where law requires it, certified copy only if mortgaged); art. 57 categories A1 <=125 cm3 / 11 kW and A above, age 18; art. 57(6)/(8) IDP of a 1968 Vienna Convention state together with national licence, max 3 years; art. 9 ban on handing a vehicle to an ineligible person; xe gắn máy definition (<=50 cm3 or 4 kW and <=50 km/h, from 16, no licence but papers/helmet/alcohol rules remain); B-only licence gives no motorcycle category on the IDP; Canada/Quebec not in the 1968 participant table (phrased 'n'entre pas dans le cas prévu par la loi vietnamienne, renseignez-vous auprès des autorités'); residents: exchange via ministry circular, 'vérifiez la version en vigueur'. France-Diplomatie and Belgian FPS statements used as in digest (seen in search result, wording kept to snippet). No fine amounts, no blanket 'sans permis' / 'permis international suffit' (the page states the opposite and tells readers to ask 'de quelle catégorie de véhicule' a loueur speaks). 'Vérifié le 30 octobre 2026' placed next to the legal block. Removed mannered claims about shop practice; deposit/passport/insurance/assistance only as generic 'certains loueurs demandent... demandez la règle applicable' and as questions to ask. Insurance: obligatory civil-liability certificate vs rental cover vs travel insurance; amounts/extent of the compulsory cover explicitly not verified (Decree 67/2023 not read). Shop NAP and hours as in SEO-FACTS; no price quoted; no policy affirmed ('conditions ... à confirmer avant de réserver').
evidence.INTENT: Main question: which papers must I check before leaving with a rental motorbike in Vietnam? OWNER of « louer une moto au Vietnam ». Differs from location-moto-hanoi/location-moto-inspection-liste-controle (mechanical inspection) because this page is the legal/paperwork checklist (licence, registration, insurance, contract); mechanical checks are left to the specific brake/chain/oil/tyre guides.
evidence.CONTENT: Full rewrite: removed abstract 'quatre piliers' prose, silo/process wording ('page du silo'), invented usage claims; new structure: summary table of 4 checks (À vérifier / Trace à garder), licence section with country list and sources, papers of the moto, three levels of insurance, contract + condition photos, questions to ask before booking (with NAP/hours), 5 FAQ, further reading. Words 1988 -> 2216.
